crossRefs.note: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

translations.web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
translations.bsb: An honest witness does not deceive, but a dishonest witness pours forth lies.
translations.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
translations.asv: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.
